nameChecks.en: Training to Inherit the Name of a Star

nameChecks.ja: 保護と抑制のための甲冑

gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto IX part 1/2 records. Guide aliases for Training to Inherit the Name of a Star and Armor of Protection & Repression are resolved by their passive IDs; spacing, Roman numeral, and Effloresced E.G.O variants use matching status or passive records. Sora's Let These Hands be the Proxy... follows the enemy skill rather than the Identity variant. Mang follows passive 999907. The Ren/Albina withdrawal thresholds, distinct-skill weakening, shared Sora HP pool, and NPC support conditions are retained.

lead.text: A 4-Sinner fight against 2 enemies. Reduce Ren's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken Albina's finisher with 3 separate attacks beforehand. Avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain” turns.

listLead.text: A 4-member battle against 2 enemies. Reduce one enemy's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken the other's major skill by landing 3 separate attacks first. Hold back during Iron Veil turns.

statNote.text: Normal 9-18. Only Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor may deploy; Ryōshū is required. No initial enemy Level reduction. Ren triggers reinforcements at 760 HP and withdraws below 490; Albina withdraws below 680. Neither must be reduced to 0 HP.

priorities.0.text: Have Sinners other than Ryōshū handle Ren's clashes and reduce Moonlit Azure Blade.

priorities.1.text: Hit “Repressed Flesh” with 3 separate attacks before its clash.

priorities.2.text: Do not attack into “Iron Curtain”. Offsetting does not remove the enhanced reflection.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Albina's finisher seems impossible to beat

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: “Repressed Flesh” is not a raw-Power contest. Damage her with 3 skills before use to reach 3 Impact-rattled Armor and reduce Final Power by 30, then clash.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: An attacking ally suddenly takes massive damage

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: “Iron Curtain” multiplies Albina's Spikes reflection by 20. Offsetting the defense skill does not remove it; stop attacking and use defense or healing.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Moonlit Azure Blade drops by 1 each time he takes damage, but Poise gained beyond 25 replenishes it. Use multiple Coins and target Swerve/Defend slots to limit Poise gains too.

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with 50 Moonlit Azure Blade. At Turn Start, gains Shield equal to its value × 5.

units.0.notes.1.text: Before Albina appears, HP cannot fall below 760; reaching it immediately ends the turn. Reinforcements also arrive at the start of turn 6.

units.0.notes.2.text: Withdraws below 490 HP. If Albina withdraws first, Ren gains 2 action slots.

units.1.notes.0.text: Joins at 30 SP; allies other than Ryōshū gain 1 action slot.

units.1.notes.1.text: At roughly 60% HP, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn once. Check the following “Iron Curtain”.

units.1.notes.2.text: Protection, Defense Level Up, and Shield vary. Do not permanently include them in the table's Defense Level 65.

phases.0.title.text: Level the 4 available Sinners and prepare Slash defense

phases.0.steps.0.text: Aim for the recommended Level 58 on Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor. Enemies are Level 65 with no reduction support. If clashes are unwinnable, consider leveling closer to 60 or using a Sapling of Light ability.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally survives. Maintain the other 3 Sinners' HP and prepare healing and powerful clash handlers.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Slash works against Ren; Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony against Albina. Prepare finisher clashes and healing as well as suitable affinities.

phases.1.title.text: Reduce Moonlit Azure Blade with multiple Coins

phases.1.steps.0.text: The opening uses Swerve, Defend, and Reflect. Targeting Swerve and Defend reduces their Combat Start Poise/Count gains. Clashable Guard cannot be Offset by defense skills.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Moonlit Azure Blade falls by 1 per instance of damage. Reduce it with multi-Coin attacks while preventing replenishment from Poise gains beyond 25.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Ren loses 2 Clash Power against Sinners other than Ryōshū. Have the other 3 handle dangerous attacks and use Ryōshū for damage or healing. Reaching 760 HP ends the turn; avoid excessive follow-ups.

phases.2.title.text: Focus Ren before the heavily defended Albina

phases.2.steps.0.text: Albina joins at turn 6's start or the turn after Ren reaches 760 HP. Other Sinners gain slots; reorganize necessary clashes and one-sided attacks.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Albina initially has Protection, Defense Level Up, and Shield. Stop necessary attacks while focusing Ren below 490 HP to make him withdraw.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Fallstar Slayer has 8 Attack Weight and Unbreakable Coins. Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to reduce damage by 80% and prevent Stagger from this skill. Account for Moonlit Azure Blade's bonuses; use Paralyze to limit Coin Power if available.

phases.3.title.text: Resolve 3 attacks before the final clash

phases.3.steps.0.text: At 2 Corpus Ingredient, Albina gains Artwork: Fascia and uses “Repressed Flesh”. Spikes is inactive on the turn the skill is equipped.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Before the finisher, damage Albina with 3 separate attack skills. Each skill, including E.G.O, grants 1 Impact-rattled Armor. A single 3-Coin skill counts only once.

phases.3.steps.2.text: At 3 Armor, the finisher loses 30 Final Power. Check action order for 3 early attacks and 1 final clash. After attacking, she is Staggered through next turn and supplies less Protection/Shield; exploit the opening.

phases.4.title.text: Survive “Iron Curtain” and damage her until withdrawal

phases.4.steps.0.text: At roughly 811 HP, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn once. If “Iron Curtain” follows, avoid attacking Albina. Offsetting does not remove the ×20 Spikes reflection.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Use strong-reflection turns for healing and defense, then concentrate damage during debuffs or Stagger. Albina withdraws below 680 HP; the encounter ends if Ren has withdrawn too.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Stagger prevention after winning a finisher clash applies to that skill's damage. It does not prevent death from Bleed or other hits.

skills.0.effects.1.text: - If an attack skill has this skill's slot as its main target, gain 4 less Poise Potency from this effect

skills.0.response.text: Targeting this Evade slot reduces its Combat Start Poise gain from 8 to 4. Use an attack that can beat the Evade to limit Poise buildup.

skills.1.effects.2.text: - If an attack skill has this skill's slot as its main target, gain 2 less Poise Count from this effect

skills.1.response.text: A Clashable Guard. Targeting it reduces the initial Poise Count gain from 4 to 2. Unlike ordinary Guard, it cannot be removed through a defense Offset.

skills.2.response.text: A Clashable Counter. Winning reduces enemy Poise Count by 1. Grace reduces his Clash Power by 2 against anyone except Ryōshū, making those Sinners suitable handlers.

skills.3.response.text: A Slash attack with 3 Attack Weight. Poise critical hits and post-attack additional damage are dangerous. Stop it with a winning regular skill and maintain secondary targets' HP.

skills.4.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Slash Fragility next turn

skills.4.response.text: 3 Attack Weight, inflicting next-turn Slash Fragility. Keep it off low-HP Sinners and save healing for the later Fallstar Slayer.

skills.5.effects.0.text: Can be clashed regardless of Speed

skills.5.effects.1.text: Damage +1% per 1 own Moonlit Azure Blade

skills.5.effects.2.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 10 own Moonlit Azure Blade

skills.5.effects.3.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger targets

skills.5.effects.6.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal Slash damage equal to this Coin's final damage

skills.5.response.text: 8 Attack Weight and Unbreakable Coins. Can be clashed regardless of Speed; winning reduces damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from this skill. Moonlit Azure Blade also raises Coin Power; prepare powerful skills and Paralyze.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to (own Moonlit Azure Blade × 10)

skills.6.response.text: Gains Shield equal to Moonlit Azure Blade × 10 at Combat Start. Offsetting alone does not undo this Shield; reduce Moonlit Azure Blade by the previous turn.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Clash Win] Gain 1 Moonlit Azure Blade

skills.7.response.text: An enemy win adds Moonlit Azure Blade and Poise. Clash with someone other than Ryōshū to prevent rebuilding the Shield.

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Clash Win] Gain 1 Moonlit Azure Blade

skills.8.response.text: A 3-Coin skill; enemy clash wins grant Moonlit Azure Blade. Limit both it and Poise buildup. Prioritize Ren over the newly arrived Albina.

skills.9.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.9.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.9.response.text: Power increases against targets with 6+ Bleed. Avoid repeated hits on Bleeding Sinners; stop it with regular skills.

skills.10.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.

skills.10.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.10.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.10.response.text: Inflicts Bleed Count and Bind while the enemy gains Haste, making next-turn redirection harder. Prepare a winning handler.

skills.11.effects.0.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 4 Bleed on the target (max 2)

skills.11.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Power Down next turn

skills.11.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Power Up next turn

skills.11.response.text: A 3-Coin skill gaining Coin Power per 4 Bleed. Avoid high-Bleed main targets and prevent next-turn Power Down.

skills.12.effects.0.text: [On Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage

skills.12.effects.2.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 10 Bleed

skills.12.effects.4.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Bleed Count

skills.12.effects.6.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal 5 SP damage

skills.12.response.text: 3 Unbreakable Coins. Winning reduces damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from the skill, but on-hit Corpus Ingredient remains. Begin preparing for the next “Repressed Flesh”.

skills.13.effects.0.text: On the turn this skill is equipped, apply the following effects:

skills.13.effects.1.text: - Before this skill is used, gain 1 Impact-rattled Armor when damaged by an attack skill (once per enemy skill, including E.G.O)

skills.13.effects.2.text: - "Iron Maiden - Spikes" Effect does not activate

skills.13.effects.3.text: - Cannot be Staggered until this skill is used

skills.13.effects.4.text: On Kill with this skill, heal 15 SP

skills.13.effects.5.text: [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 4 Bleed on the target (max 4)

skills.13.effects.6.text: [On Use] Damage +10% per 2 Bleed on the target (max 100%)

skills.13.effects.7.text: [On Clash Lose] This skill's damage cannot Stagger targets

skills.13.effects.10.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal 5 SP damage

skills.13.effects.13.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn

skills.13.effects.16.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Damage Down next turn

skills.13.effects.17.text: [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn

skills.13.effects.19.text: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Bind next turn

skills.13.response.text: Damage her with 3 separate attack skills before use to reach 3 Impact-rattled Armor, reducing Final Power by 30 before clashing. A single 3-Coin skill does not grant 3 stacks. Spikes is inactive this turn.

skills.14.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] When damaged by an attack skill, increase the attacker's Bleed Count by 1 (including E.G.O)

skills.14.response.text: At Combat Start, gains an effect that increases attackers' Bleed Count when hit. Spikes also reflects damage; avoid unnecessary attacks and prioritize Ren.

skills.15.effects.0.text: This turn, Iron Maiden - Spikes deals 20 times its normal damage to enemies (this effect is not removed by Offset)

skills.15.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] On taking attack-skill damage, increase the attacker's Bleed Count by 1 (including E.G.O)

skills.15.response.text: Spikes reflection is multiplied by 20 and survives Offset. Avoid attacking Albina this turn; use defense or healing on high-Bleed Sinners.

passives.0.name.text: Training to Inherit the Name of a Star

passives.0.effect.text: After an attack skill ends, deal Slash damage to each target equal to (number of Slash Coins that critically hit × 10). This damage cannot Stagger

passives.0.condition.text: Slash Coin critical hits / after attacking

passives.0.response.text: Additional damage still removes HP even without Stagger. Limit Poise buildup and heal.

passives.1.effect.text: At encounter start, gain 50 Moonlit Azure Blade

passives.1.response.text: Starts with 50 Moonlit Azure Blade. Use multi-Coin attacks to reduce it.

passives.2.effect.text:
While holding Moonlit Azure Blade:
- SP cannot fall below 0; if below 0, set it to 0.
- SP damage received becomes Gloom damage (excluding basic SP gain/loss rules).

passives.2.condition.text: While Moonlit Azure Blade is present

passives.2.response.text: Do not rely on lowering SP below 0. SP damage becomes Gloom damage.

passives.3.effect.text: When clashing against someone other than Ryōshū, Clash Power -2. Take 20% less damage from targets other than Ryōshū

passives.3.condition.text: Clashes / damage from someone other than Ryōshū

passives.3.response.text: Other Sinners reduce enemy Clash Power by 2 but deal 20% less damage. Use Ryōshū's actions for damage or other roles.

passives.4.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: SP resets to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a solution.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.response.text: Do not rely on replacing Panic type to disable strong attacks.

passives.6.effect.text:
Poise Potency caps at 25.
Poise Potency gained beyond 25 becomes Moonlit Azure Blade.

passives.6.response.text: Excess gains replenish Moonlit Azure Blade. Do not ignore Poise-generating defense slots or hits.

passives.7.effect.text:
At Turn End with 2 Corpus Ingredient, remove it next turn and gain Artwork: Fascia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Fascia, use a powerful attack this turn.

Before using the powerful attack, gain 1 Impact-rattled Armor when damaged by an attack skill.

passives.7.condition.text: 2 Corpus Ingredient / preparing the powerful attack

passives.7.response.text: When “Repressed Flesh” appears, prepare 3 earlier attacks.

passives.8.effect.text:
Take 30% less HP/SP damage and Stagger Threshold increase from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking.
Take 50% less Bleed damage.

passives.8.response.text: Bleed is reduced by 50%; the other listed effects by 30%. Use the opening after the finisher rather than forcing through with statuses alone.

passives.9.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.9.response.text: SP resets to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a solution.

passives.10.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.10.response.text: Do not rely on replacing Panic type to disable strong attacks.

passives.11.effect.text:
At Turn Start while not Staggered, gain 2 Protection, 10 Defense Level Up, and Shield equal to 10% current HP.

For each use of “Repressed Flesh” this encounter, reduce these gains by 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and 5 percentage points of Shield.

passives.11.response.text: Initially grants 2 Protection, +10 Defense Level, and 10% current HP Shield. Weakens with each “Repressed Flesh” use; focus Ren until then.

passives.12.effect.text:
While not Staggered, when damaged by an attacker's final Coin:
- Deal Pierce damage to the attacker equal to 20% of that Coin's damage and inflict 2 Bleed (max 100 damage per skill).
- This effect's damage cannot Stagger.

passives.12.condition.text: Damage from an attacker's final Coin while not Staggered

passives.12.response.text: Returns reflected damage and Bleed. Especially avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain”; “Repressed Flesh”'s preparation turn is the exception.

passives.13.effect.text:
On entry, heal 30 SP.

At 60% HP or lower, recover from Stagger and end the turn (once per encounter).

passives.13.condition.text: Entry / 60% HP or lower, once per encounter

passives.13.response.text: At roughly 811 HP, Stagger clears and the turn ends. Avoid follow-ups into the subsequent “Iron Curtain”.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Ryōshū gains +1 slot and +10% damage against Spiderweb. On Stagger, recover next turn and gain 1 Attack Power Up (once per encounter). Cannot retreat.

mechanics.0.response.text: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. Divide roles while preserving allied HP.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Max 50. At Turn Start, gain Shield equal to value × 5; critical damage +1% per stack. Decreases by 1 when taking damage.

mechanics.1.response.text: Reduce through multiple Coins and prevent replenishment from excess Poise gains.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Max 2. Gained through “Fascia Hungers” hits and other effects; at 2, the Turn End condition prepares the next finisher.

mechanics.2.response.text: Unbreakable hits can remain; prepare 3 earlier attacks promptly.

mechanics.3.effect.text: At Turn Start, gain 4 Base Power Up. Inflicting Bleed through attack skills adds 2 Power. Expires after “Repressed Flesh” attacks.

mechanics.3.response.text: Do not judge the finisher's Power solely from base values.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Max 3. Each stack reduces “Repressed Flesh”'s Final Power by 10. After attacking at 3 stacks, expires and causes Stagger through next turn.

mechanics.4.response.text: Build stacks with 3 separate attacks, then clash with the final skill.

warnings.0.text: “Repressed Flesh” counts skills for its debuff. One 3-Coin skill does not grant 3 Armor.

warnings.1.text: “Iron Curtain”'s enhanced reflection survives Offset. Do not confuse it with the “Repressed Flesh” preparation turn.

warnings.2.text: The turn ends at 60% Albina HP. Follow-up attacks after Stagger may not all resolve.

warnings.3.text: Ryōshū's protection requires another living ally. Keep the other 3 alive.

preparation.0.text: Recommended Level 58. Level all 4 available Sinners and bring healing against Slash/Bleed plus strong finisher clash skills.

preparation.1.text: Use multiple Coins, Paralyze, and Bind when available. Status mitigation means they should not be the only plan.

roles.0.reason.text: Use his reduced Power against Sinners other than Ryōshū to stop dangerous attacks.

roles.1.name.text: 3 early attacks and a final clash

roles.1.reason.text: Weaken “Repressed Flesh” before taking it on.

roles.2.reason.text: Survive “Iron Curtain” turns and recover from Bleed/Unbreakable attrition.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-18「レン・アルビナ」の攻略。4人で: Ren & Albina guide for Limbus Company 9-18. A 4-Sinner fight against 2 enemies. Reduce Ren's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken Albina's finisher with 3 separate attacks beforehand. Avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain” turns.
